nodes.name: application.yaml
nodes.summary: Base Spring Boot configuration defining application name, active profile, mail/SMTP settings, PostgreSQL datasource with HikariCP pool tuning, JPA/Hibernate settings, OAuth2 client registrations (Google, GitHub), Spring AI OpenAI chat and pgvector settings, MCP client connection, Supabase, Swagger, AI-service client, mentor RAG toggle, seed account credentials, and roadmap auto-completion threshold.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Spring property placeholders (${VAR:default}) to externalize secrets and environment-specific values, keeping credentials out of the repo.

nodes.name: application-dev.yaml
nodes.summary: Spring Boot 'dev' profile overlay enabling SQL statement logging and DEBUG-level logging for Spring Security and the project's own packages.

nodes.name: application-prod.yaml
nodes.summary: Spring Boot 'prod' profile overlay activated for production deployments, tuning logging levels for a live environment.
